Seminar Title:

Characterization of non-singular hyperplanes of H(s, q^2) in PG(s, q^2)

Seminar Type:

Departmental Seminar

Department:

Mathematics

Speaker Name:

Ms. Suti Mohanty

Speaker Type:

Student

Venue:

Seminar Room (Department of Mathematics)

Date and Time:

08 Sep 2026 11:00 am

Contact:

Dr. Bikramaditya sahu

Abstract:

In this paper, we present a combinatorial characterization of the non-singular hyperplanes defined with respect to a non-singular Hermitian variety H(s, q^2) in in the projective space PG(s, q^2) where s ≥ 3 and q > 2. By analyzing the intersection numbers of hyperplanes with points and co-dimension 2 subspaces, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions for a collection of hyperplanes to be the set of all non-singular hyperplanes of a Hermitian variety. This approach extends previous characterizations of Hermitian varieties based on intersection properties, providing a purely combinatorial method for identifying the known set of hyperplanes. Keywords: Hermitian variety, Non-singular hyperplane, Projective space.
